value.rationale: The 11-point biplane is a canonical highly symmetric 2-(11,5,2) design, and the full PSL(2,11) action is its natural full automorphism symmetry; its exact degree-two homology module is a motivated, natural invariant. Although the sphere count and affine action were published before, distinguishing the two possible degree-ten full-group constituents via involution Lefschetz traces and showing full quotient rational acyclicity gives genuinely finer equivariant topological information not implied by those records. This is a substantive finite invariant rather than an arbitrary slice. No new integral G-lattice, equivariant wedge decomposition, or all-biplane classification is claimed.

final_claim: The 11-point 2-(11,5,2) biplane block-facet complex K is wedge of 21 integral 2-spheres, and the full 660-element simplicial PSL(2,11) action has rational H2 character (21,-3,0,0,1,-1) on classes of orders (1,2,3,6,5,11), decomposed as V10-minus direct sum V11, giving no full-group invariant but one order55 affine invariant. Prior October 2026 work already establishes the same integral wedge and entire affine restriction; novelty is restricted to the full 660-group character refinement.
limitations: The 21-sphere nonequivariant homotopy and 55-element affine subgroup character are ALREADY published for precisely this complex; not a novel part of the claimed result.
No equivariant wedge or integral PSL module decomposition, no integral quotient acyclicity or topological contractibility; quotient acyclicity is reduced rational homology only.
